name: HI-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with +13 partisan lean
Incumbent Ed Case running with over $1M raised
Prediction markets price Democratic win at 96%
model.rationale: The district's +13 Democratic lean, Case's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and markets pricing a Democratic win at 96% all point to a comfortable hold, with no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise.
model.watch: Any late polling showing an unusually strong Republican challenger or a major outside-spending intervention would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ed Case seeks another term in a Honolulu-based district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He has raised over $1 million and holds a large cash advantage, while Republican Adriel Lam and minor-party candidates show no reported fundraising or outside support. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Case roughly a 96% chance of winning.

The fundamentals strongly favor the incumbent: the seat's partisan lean, a modestly favorable national environment for Democrats, and incumbency advantages all point the same direction. Barring an unforeseen shock, Case is positioned for an easy re-election in this safely Democratic seat.
